newsitem.title: USA: Rubin warns against increase in Japan c/a surplus.
newsitem.headline: Rubin warns against increase in Japan c/a surplus.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin warned against a sustained increase in Japan's current account surplus on Monday.

"The question is will there be a sustained increase in the current account surplus?" Rubin said in response to reporters' questions following a speech to the Japan Society. "And if so I think that is a very serious problem."
Regarding long-standing United States support of a strong dollar, Rubin said, "Our policy on the dollar, as you know, has remained constant and continues to be the same."
Rubin also said that it was important to remain "watchful of inflation."

In reference to President Clinton's decision earlier on Monday to renew China's most favored nation status and the impending battle to push the policy through Congress, Rubin said, "I think we will be successful. It's the right thing to do."
